optimizersodiumaddon.option.gpu_leak_fix: Frees the video memory of render targets that the garbage collector discards without closing them.
Distance haze, including the thick Nether fog. Blindness and Darkness fog is never touched.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.overlay_wate: The water texture drawn over your view while swimming.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.overlay_fire: The flames drawn over your view while burning.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_max.to: Maximum number of armor stands drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_distan: Maximum distance in blocks to draw armor stands.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_hide_i: Do not process invisible armor stands with nothing equipped; they look the same.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.item_max.too: Maximum number of dropped items drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.item_distanc: Maximum distance in blocks to draw dropped items.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.xp_max.toolt: Maximum number of experience orbs drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
Maximum distance in blocks to draw experience orbs.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_tot: Maximum number of particles alive at once. 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_per: Maximum number of new particles per tick. 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_dis: Particles farther than this many blocks are not created.
